{{Top|leg}}
A '''guild-apprentice''' was a young [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] who aspired to join a hive's [[crafts-guild]]. Guild-apprentices who were children of [[guildmember]]s were often bequeathed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] by them in the hopes that they acquired knowledge to gain acceptance into the guild.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
